name: Phone P-011 sidecar outbound usage-admission mutation guard, re-run after the WI-10006406/WI-10006404 sidecar edits
command: scripts/mutation-probe.sh --file "$PHONE_APP_ROOT/apps/sidecar/src/calls.ts" --relocation overlay --mutate 's/return dispatchPhoneUsage\(usage, intent, \(\) => this\.createDialRequest\(store, number, options\)\);/return this.createDialRequest(store, number, options);/' --test "cd $PHONE_APP_ROOT/apps/sidecar && npx vitest run src/api.test.ts src/telephony.e2e.test.ts"  # papercusp root, PAPERCUSP_TEST_RUN_HARNESS=papercusp
summary: 1/1 copy-out overlay mutant CAUGHT. The sidecar suites (api.test.ts + telephony.e2e.test.ts) passed against the canonical and the relocated canonical snapshot, then a mutant of apps/sidecar/src/calls.ts in which prepareOutboundCall dials WITHOUT the usage admission (dispatchPhoneUsage bypassed) failed 2 tests | 79 passed: 'durable carrier preparation > prepares one outbound intent for retries and refuses another tenant's number' and 'admits outbound dials only inside the D-021 owner approval, durably across sidecar restart'. Re-runs the sidecar probe from docs/evidence/phone-p011-usage-mutations-2026-10-06.json at phone-app subject commit 9d8f007f28d58ee92e508bcc6ce8e134843128af, because the WI-10006406 (deleteCallContent) and WI-10006404 (take-over metadata) edits re-fingerprinted calls.ts and api.test.ts. Software falsifiability only; no live Telnyx billing, CDR, PSTN or shipment claim (D-020).
